refresh_2026_08_11.facts: Z-2025-036 requested Heavy Industrial zoning for approximately 4,000 acres at approximately 11000 N McCornick Road for Joule Capital Partners LLC.
County Commission agenda noticed possible adoption of Ordinance 25-08-05 changing approximately 4,000 acres at approximately 11000 N McCornick Road from AG-20/AG to HI.
Planning Commission unanimously recommended approval of C-2 CUP application #Z-2025-048 for data center and electrical generating facility at approximately 11000 N McCornick Road.
BOCC unanimously approved C-2 CUP amendment #Z-2025-048 for the data center and electrical generating facility.
Agenda noticed Z-2026-026 and Ordinance 26-05-19B for a Joule 24-inch natural gas pipeline project between Holden and McCornick.
Minutes show the Joule pipeline development agreement public hearing occurred, but additional agreement work was needed before approval.
Grand County data-center inventory lists Joule HP Compute Campus Phase 1 in Delta/Millard County at 455 MW and UNDER CONST.; full campus listed as 4,000+ MW proposed.
Joule says the Millard County campus has an executed conditional use permit, heavy industrial zoning in place, on-site behind-the-meter power, and generation equipment on firm order/in production.
Cleanview lists the High Performance Compute Data Center Campus in Millard County as planned, 4,000 MW, 4,000 acres, developed by Joule Capital Partners.

contradictions.description: Grand County's compiled inventory lists Joule Phase 1 as UNDER CONST., while the retrieved Millard County primary records prove zoning/CUP approval but do not expose a building permit, site-disturbance approval, CO, utility service, energization, or live-service record. Joule's current page states generation equipment is on firm order and in production, which may be off-site manufacturing rather than on-site construction.
contradictions.resolution: Use status tier approved-permitted; retain the UNDER CONST. claim as a source-specific claim pending Millard building/site-work or energization evidence.

contradictions.resolution: Track phase1_mw=455 and full_buildout_mw=4000 separately; do not treat 4,000 MW as energized or currently available capacity.
